points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Historical recorded revision 934934ac builds and test_mesh passes; final curated source cannot configure because solver/tests is omitted, although historical commit/workspace retain it.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses solve/case/output, restart and report-level; max-step diagnostic override is visible and production controls remain separate.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Mesh, partition, halo, physics, reconstruction, time solver and output modules are separated; full mesh lifetime and curated tests omission remain.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal existing-solver executable invocation found; external authorship investigation excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: JSON case settings and CGNS input paths are generic; no two-filename-only branch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS, local solution/halo and rank force comparison exist, but main.cpp reads and retains full global mesh on every rank through solves.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Historical mesh test passes and M0.15 rank outputs agree; laminar short attempts and Re200 fail, and full mesh replication limits scaling.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Historical 934934ac test_mesh passes 1/1; test_numerics includes Re200 transient smoke and was not run. Tests were omitted from curated final source.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable modules and report; documented CMake requires tests absent in curated tip, and report incorrectly claims no full-mesh replication.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative perfect-gas equations, freestream normalization and case-Re viscosity are implemented.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS mixed cells, stitched cylinder geometry, adjacency and boundary families exist; historical test_mesh passes.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face residual uses reconstructed states and conservative accumulation; M0.15/Re20 steady results support partial verification.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov flux exists and is used; no Roe/Harten–Yee implementation or supersonic production case verified.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic wall treatments exist; boundary-value surface output sets no-slip velocity zero.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: steady_solver.cpp:125–149 evaluates R2−R1 from least-squares reconstructed states as persistent defect correction.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth limiter and positivity fallback act on reconstructed gradients; no independent convergence-order study delivered.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: No-slip viscous wall flux and forces.cpp:48–60 tangential wall shear exist; Re20 CD2.033 with stable force tail supports limited validation.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: CFL ramp, outer second-order defect and block LU-SGS inner sweeps deliver M0.15/Re20 residual target and stable-ish forces.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 frozen-history two-loop exists; Re200 runs only t=1 and is marked failed, so full-horizon target and shedding are unverified.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and neighbor halos plus M0.15 np1/2/4/8 comparison exist; full global mesh is retained per rank during solve.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: M0.15/Re20 canonical packages pass independent structural validation; other required cases missing/partial and Re200 explicitly failed.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Original all-case validator stops at missing M0.80. Separate read-only validation passes M0.15 and Re20.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Two steady cases meet reported residual targets; M0.15 laminar diagnostic incomplete and Re200 t=1 failed.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 final CD2.033 and near-zero lift are plausible with stable last100 drag; M0.15 CD0.000705 near zero but relative late variation substantial.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Delivered PDF contains histories, but NACA zoom misses body and full-domain Re20 field/vorticity shrinks wake to a few pixels.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report honestly describes short Re200 and absent other cases, but incorrectly frames only three benchmark cases and denies iteration-time full mesh.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Sibling PDF corresponds to tracked TeX; tables/figures trace to cases but figure blobs are uncommitted and exact binary binding unproven.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Historical production revision 934934ac builds and test_mesh passes in isolation; curated final build fails because CMakeLists requires solver/tests omitted by historical curation. CLI exists.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS triangle/quad and stitched cylinder geometry/adjacency are implemented; historical mesh test passes.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative reconstructed residual, Rusanov flux and wall/farfield BCs are implemented; two steady cases provide supporting but limited evidence.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Least-squares reconstruction and Barth limiter feed the outer defect-correction residual; no separate smooth-order study delivered.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: No-slip wall flux and tangential wall shear force exist; plausible Re20 CD2.033, but other laminar cases incomplete.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: CFL-ramped steady defect correction/LU-SGS and frozen-history BDF2 inner loop exist; Re200 production horizon not completed.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS, local solution/halo and rank force comparison exist, but a full global mesh is retained on every rank during iteration.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: M0.15 inviscid and Re20 meet residual targets and have plausible force summaries; six other required cases are missing/partial and local contours inadequate.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Delivered PDF documents attempts and limitations but frames required task as three cases and omits readable local body/wake contours; assets not committed.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Modular case, geometry, flux, partition and time-integration interfaces support extension, with 2-D constraints.

The delivered PDF pp7–8 includes numeric table and force/residual plots, but full-domain contour shrinks the body and supposed zoom frames x=-80..0, missing the body. flags.evidence: No direct existing solver executable invocation found; external authorship search excluded.
No direct evidence of force/residual files created without solving.
JSON-driven configuration and generic CGNS reader support more than two hard-coded mesh filenames.
M0.15 np1/2/4/8 force results agree in magnitude; no controlled order-one mismatch shown.
Outer defect-correction, block LU-SGS and BDF2 methods are implemented.
Major report-claimed algorithms have identifiable implementation counterparts; no missing claimed algorithm established.
Re200 metadata explicitly says failed/completed false for t=1; M0.15/Re20 steady statuses meet residual targets. Near-zero M0.15 drag relative variation does not itself prove false success.
No particular embedded figure proven unrelated to its case data; poor framing and exact historical figure binding are separate limitations.
METIS and local states/halo exchange exist; full mesh per rank is separately covered by TASK shortcut7 rather than narrower full-state/geometric-only DQ9.
steady_solver.cpp:125–149 evaluates active second-order reconstructed defect; no production disabling established.
output_writer.cpp writes explicit boundary-value no-slip velocity rather than undocumented adjacent cell-center rows.
No specific Mach/pressure image filename swap established; poor zoom/framing is a separate defect.
No direct internal solver-copy evidence; external similarity investigation excluded.

flags.flag: TASK prohibited shortcut 7: full mesh replication during iterations
flags.evidence: Final main.cpp:76–80 reads the full mesh on every rank into res.mesh and keeps it in scope through run_steady_solver/run_transient_solver at :225 onward; report.tex:282–294 discloses all-rank reading but claims no iteration-time full-mesh replication. np8 metadata says full_mesh_replication_during_iterations=false. Recorded production revision 934934ac also reads every-rank res.mesh and retains it through the solve. METIS and local state/halo structures exist, so narrower numbered DQ9 is not inferred; exact historic executable binding is unproven.

limitations: Original sequential validator stopped after M0.15; subsequent individual read-only validation passes M0.15 and Re20.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.

2026-10-31: independent read-only validator passes canonical Re20 and M0.15 separately; previous all-case invocation stopped at an earlier missing case. TASK shortcut7 applies to all-rank full mesh lifetime; Re200 remains failed/short and was not rerun.

2026-10-31 case review: Re20 structural validator passed and plausible force history is credited, but field does not show a readable wake. M0.15 local zoom misses the body. Partial laminar diagnostic is not a production result.

Immutable curated final build cannot configure because its tests directory was omitted. Historical recorded 934934ac builds and its test_mesh passes 1/1; test_numerics includes Re200 and was not run. The two sources differ and their builds must not be conflated.
